confidence: medium-high; repository facts support the plan, while capacity thresholds and provider batch limits remain measurements to obtain
details_checked: Existing ticket_search_documents uniqueness and vector dimensions make in-place chunk migration unsafe for rollback.
Existing refresh does not hold a database transaction across the provider call and already has hash/identity revalidation patterns to preserve.
Existing retrieval security predicates and context/citation controls must be reused before every v2 limit, fusion input, cache/snapshot use, and packing step.
Existing stack already has PostgreSQL/pgvector and HNSW/GIN capabilities; no workload evidence justifies an external vector database.

implementation_options.decision: defer as a limited compatibility baseline
implementation_options.rationale: Deliver query-cache and batch primitives in phase 1, but it cannot meet chunking or true-fusion requirements.
Use rank-only RRF over independently authorized lexical and vector candidate pools.
Additive dual-write/shadow-read/cutover preserves v1 rollback and accommodates chunks safely.
Breaks v1 uniqueness and reader/writer assumptions, complicates dimension DDL, and lacks a safe partial-deploy rollback.

Adds processor, authorization, reconciliation, cost, and network risks without evidence; reconsider only after a 1M-chunk benchmark and production measurements show tuned pgvector misses gates or materially harms ticketing DB headroom.

implementation_options.decision: implement deterministic only; defer model reranking
implementation_options.rationale: RRF plus authority/diversity is auditable and meets one-model constraint; separate cross-encoder violates it and same-LLM reranking adds latency, nondeterminism, and injection surface. Conditional review agent may assess the immutable context but may not rerank/retrieve in v1.

implementation_options.decision: implement process-local query-embedding cache and per-job snapshot; defer retrieval-result cache and shared persistent query cache
implementation_options.rationale: Smallest safe cache set; process-local cache stores only normalized-query hash plus vector, is TTL-bounded, and never crosses tenant/authorization identity. PostgreSQL query cache and retrieval-result cache require separate data-classification/retention and invalidation approval.

implementation_options.decision: implement B+C+bounded cache in phases, with A+B as an early shadow-read milestone
implementation_options.rationale: This retains current service during migration and makes future external-store adaptation possible behind a retrieval interface.

proposed_artifact.title: Tickety RAG v2: chunked hybrid pgvector retrieval with durable embedding refresh and immutable authorized snapshots
proposed_artifact.decision: Implement a parallel PostgreSQL/pgvector v2 chunk store, deterministic hybrid retrieval, bounded process-local query-embedding cache, and one immutable context snapshot per AI job. Keep v1 live through dual write and shadow read; do not add a vector DB, a reranker model, retrieval-result cache, or a second production model.

architecture.write_path: Source change emits/updates a narrow durable embedding-refresh lease row in PostgreSQL. A worker claims rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, builds deterministic chunks from a freshly read source, batch-embeds up to configured size, then commits only current chunks in a short replacement transaction after source/hash/state/identity validation. Provider calls occur outside DB transactions.
architecture.read_path: Normalize query, calculate auth_scope_fingerprint from current viewer/tenant/assignment/private/portal/KB-authority policy, start lexical candidates on a dedicated short-lived read session, and concurrently obtain the query vector from cache or provider. Vector candidates use another short-lived read session after vector availability. Each SQL path applies all authorization predicates before its per-family candidate LIMIT. Fuse ranks, diversify, validate current source state again, pack a bounded citation set, and persist one immutable snapshot.
architecture.agent_path: The triage/retrieval agent receives snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, policy/version and citation IDs. The conditional same-model resolution/review agent receives exactly that snapshot and must cite only its allowlist. It reruns retrieval only when current corpus_generation, authorization fingerprint, embedding identity, or ticket/source revision differs; otherwise it reuses the snapshot.

schema_and_migration.migration: Additive idempotent migration in app/backend/database.py:_ensure_ticket_search_documents_v2, guarded by TICKET_RAG_V2_ENABLED and TICKET_RAG_V2_WRITE_ENABLED. Validate configured TICKET_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS is integer 1..4096 and exactly matches a persisted rag_v2_schema_meta.embedding_dimensions before any v2 writer/read flag can enable. An identity/dimension change creates a new disabled v3 migration plan rather than ALTER vector dimensions in place.
tables: ticket_search_chunks_v2(chunk_id uuid primary key, tenant_id, source_type, source_id, parent_ticket_id, chunk_index integer, section_path varchar, content text, content_hash char(64), parent_content_hash char(64), source_revision varchar, authority_json jsonb, embedding vector(D), embedding_identity varchar, embedded_at timestamptz, created_at, updated_at, unique(tenant_id, source_type, source_id, parent_content_hash, chunk_index))

ticket_embedding_refresh_v2(refresh_key varchar primary key, tenant_id, source_type, source_id, desired_parent_hash char(64), desired_revision varchar, desired_embedding_identity varchar, state varchar, lease_owner varchar nullable, lease_expires_at timestamptz nullable, attempts smallint, next_attempt_at timestamptz, last_error_kind varchar nullable, updated_at, created_at)

ai_retrieval_context_snapshots(snapshot_id uuid primary key, ai_job_id nullable unique, tenant_id, authorization_fingerprint char(64), corpus_generation bigint, embedding_identity varchar, query_hash char(64), chunk_refs jsonb, snapshot_digest char(64), expires_at timestamptz, created_at)
indexes: HNSW on ticket_search_chunks_v2.embedding vector_cosine_ops, created concurrently after seeded rows; tune ef_search per connection/request only after benchmark.
B-tree (tenant_id, source_type, source_id), (parent_ticket_id), (tenant_id, embedding_identity), and refresh state/next_attempt_at lease-claim index.
No ANN or FTS query runs without tenant and current authorization predicates; ANN candidates are authorization-filtered in the SQL candidate CTE before family LIMIT.
schema_and_migration.compatibility: V1 remains authoritative fallback while V2 reads are shadowed. V2 dual-write failures increment a metric and retry without blocking ticket writes; v1 continues to serve. Cutover only after reconciliation and gates. Rollback disables V2 read/write flags, drains/pauses v2 workers, retains v2 data read-only for investigation, and serves v1. No destructive downgrade is required; deletion is a separately approved retention operation.

chunking_and_provenance.algorithm: Canonicalize permitted source text exactly as current redaction/authority policy does; preserve title and heading markers. Split on headings, then paragraphs, then sentence boundaries only when necessary. Target 450 tokens, max 600 tokens, trailing overlap up to 50 tokens only across adjacent chunks in the same parent; emit one chunk for parents at or below target. Tokenizer/version is configured and included in chunker_identity.
chunking_and_provenance.identity: chunk_id = UUIDv5(namespace, tenant_id + source_type + source_id + parent_content_hash + chunk_index + chunker_identity). Parent text hash and each chunk content hash are SHA-256 of canonical text; section_path and source revision are stored with every chunk.
chunking_and_provenance.replacement: For a current parent, lock only that parent refresh record, validate source still eligible, delete obsolete chunks for that parent revision and upsert the exact newly computed chunk set in one short transaction. On archive/delete/unpublish/private/portal/policy ineligibility, delete all v2 chunks for the parent and invalidate related snapshot references; no tombstone is searchable.
chunking_and_provenance.citation: Retrieved chunks cite source_type/source_id plus chunk_id, section_path, and excerpt bounds; display/citation authorization resolves the live parent, not cached chunk metadata. Multiple chunks from one parent collapse to one parent citation unless separately necessary passages are retained. Model output citation IDs must be in snapshot chunk_refs; actions remain derived only from approved KB citations.

embedding_refresh.mechanism: Use narrow ticket_embedding_refresh_v2 durable leases rather than expanding generic ai_jobs in this release. Enqueue is idempotent on refresh_key and wakes workers; periodic scan re-enqueues eligible stale/missing parents, so a missed wake-up cannot lose work. Lease expiry makes worker death recoverable.
embedding_refresh.batching: Worker claims up to TICKET_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE=32 parent chunks constrained by reserved provider RPM/TPM/daily budget and max provider inputs. It calls a new _embed_texts(list[str]) once per batch while retaining existing endpoint validation, redaction, timeout, provider-concurrency lease, admission, and safe logging. Batch limits are bootstrap configuration, not provider assumptions.
embedding_refresh.validation_and_retry: Map results by required input index; require exactly one finite numeric vector of configured D dimensions per accepted item. A timeout/5xx/rate error gets at most two total attempts per item with bounded full jitter and persisted next_attempt_at. Malformed/wrong-dimension response is non-retryable for that item and alerts. For a single toxic item, split the remaining retryable subset deterministically until singleton, mark singleton failed/quarantined, and continue other items. Never log text/query/provider body.
embedding_refresh.stale_guard: Immediately before commit, reread each source and require eligible state, desired parent hash/revision, desired embedding identity, and generated chunk identities to match the lease intent. Conditional UPSERT/DELETE predicates enforce those values. A late/deleted/unpublished/superseded result is discarded and refresh row rescheduled or completed as ineligible; it never resurrects evidence.

hybrid_retrieval.candidate_generation: For each family independently query lexical and vector candidates: ticket/comment 40 each and published KB 16 each bootstrap limits. Use separate sessions/tasks or sequential same-session queries—never share SQLAlchemy Session across concurrent tasks. If vector unavailable, lexical remains valid; if lexical fails, fail closed for that family and report degraded retrieval. Candidate rows are normalized by chunk_id after live authority checks.
hybrid_retrieval.formula: For each chunk c, score(c) = sum over available lists L of weight(L)/(60 + rank_L(c)), ranks are 1-based. Initial weights are 1.0 lexical and 1.0 vector. Raw ts_rank and cosine distance are used only to establish deterministic per-list rank and are never numerically combined. Ties: higher authority class, published KB where eligible, lower best rank, source_type priority KB then ticket then comment, parent source_id, then chunk_index/chunk_id ascending.
hybrid_retrieval.diversification: Fuse per family, reserve at least two eligible published-KB passages when present, then select 6-10 total prompt passages under char/token cap with max two chunks per parent and max two per ticket; preserve existing per-ticket caps and authoritative tie-break rules. A source failing current predicates is removed before ranking and every cap, so fusion cannot reintroduce it.

caching_and_snapshots.query_cache: Per-process bounded LRU/TTL cache (bootstrap 2,000 entries, TTL 45 minutes) mapping key SHA-256(tenant_id + authorization_fingerprint + normalized_query_hash + embedding_identity + dimensions) to vector, created_at, expiry. Cache stores no raw query; vectors inherit query sensitivity, stay process-memory only, and are purged on expiry/eviction. Auth fingerprint includes current actor/role, assignment scope, private-note policy, portal policy and tenant; changed policy produces a miss.
caching_and_snapshots.snapshot: Persist only encrypted-at-rest source IDs/chunk hashes/citation metadata—not prompt or raw query—in ai_retrieval_context_snapshots. TTL is min(AI job/artifact retention, 24h bootstrap); snapshot lookup revalidates tenant, current authorization fingerprint, corpus_generation and each live source before use. Invalid/missing/expired snapshot triggers new retrieval; cross-tenant/job access fails closed. Increment tenant corpus_generation transactionally on source eligibility/content changes, and invalidate affected in-memory query results only if such cache is later introduced.
caching_and_snapshots.deferred: No retrieval-result cache in initial rollout. No PostgreSQL shared query-vector cache until security classification, encryption/key rotation, retention, and access-control review are accepted.

file_map_and_phases: Phase 0 — baseline: app/backend/ticket_vectors.py adds instrumentation-only timings/candidate counts; tests/test_ticket_vector_evidence.py adds frozen labelled fixtures; docs/rag-v2.md records baseline and flags. No behavior change.

Phase 1 — primitives: app/backend/settings.py validates RAG v2 flags, batch/cache/chunker parameters; app/backend/database.py adds v2 DDL/meta and lease/snapshot tables; app/backend/ticket_vectors.py adds canonical chunker, _embed_texts, refresh worker/lease reconciliation, in-memory cache, and v2 writer behind write flag; tests/test_database_migrations.py and tests/test_settings_security.py cover schema/dimension/flag safety.

Phase 2 — shadow retrieval: app/backend/ticket_vectors.py adds v2 lexical/vector SQL, RRF/diversifier/live validation and snapshot builder; app/backend/main.py or the existing AI request/job integration creates/binds snapshot IDs without changing agent output; app/backend/ai_interface.py (or existing agent contract module) accepts snapshot allowlist/version. Add tests/test_ticket_vector_evidence.py, tests/test_ai_pipeline.py, and tests/test_ai_interface_security.py. Compare v1/v2 metrics, do not serve v2.

Phase 3 — controlled cutover: deployment Helm values/templates and docs/rag-v2.md expose flags, worker count and bounded batch/concurrency settings; enable v2 write for a tenant canary, bounded backfill, then v2 read for that canary. Maintain v1 fallback. Promote only after all gates.

Phase 4 — steady state: retain v1 for one agreed retention window plus reconciliation; schedule index ANALYZE/reindex maintenance by measured bloat/headroom. Remove v1 only in a later separately approved migration after rollback window and export/reconciliation evidence.

verification_and_gates.test_matrix: Unit/property tests for stable chunks/overlap/IDs; SQL tests prove every predicate occurs before each candidate limit; RRF/tie/diversity tests; batch order/partial/toxic/wrong-dimension tests; lease/worker-death/missed-wakeup/database-restart tests; delayed stale update/delete/unpublish tests; snapshot tamper/expiry/auth/corpus change tests; portal/private/cross-assignee/unapproved/model-output poison tests; and v1/v2 parity/reconciliation tests.
verification_and_gates.labelled_evaluation: Build approval-reviewed fixtures with exact IDs/error codes, paraphrases, long KB, competing comments, scope-poison cases, stale sources, and no-answer cases. Report Recall@5/10, MRR or NDCG@10, KB presence, duplicate-parent rate, citation validity, grounded-action rate, and no-answer precision; never declare quality gain without a labelled comparison.
verification_and_gates.bootstrap_gates: At observed production corpus plus 100k metadata-safe chunks, require warm retrieval p95 <250ms, cached-query end-to-end retrieval p95 <400ms, cold embedding+retrieval p95 <2s, ordinary index freshness p95 <60s, zero stale/unauthorized evidence, and no material ticket API regression during concurrent backfill. Exercise synthetic 1M chunks and measure DB CPU/IO/locks/index size, rows examined, HNSW behavior and ticket API latency before considering external DB. Targets are test inputs to tune, not promised capacity.
verification_and_gates.observability: Emit cardinality-safe metrics only: cache hit/miss/age, provider latency/batch utilization/admission, refresh lag/state/retry/stale-discard, v1-v2 divergence, lexical/vector/fused counts, DB timing, p50/p95/p99, prompt passage/token count, citation/action outcomes, and LLM latency separately. Log opaque IDs/error class, never raw source/query/prompt/provider body.

rollout_stop_and_failure_policy.feature_flags: TICKET_RAG_V2_WRITE_ENABLED, TICKET_RAG_V2_SHADOW_READ_ENABLED, TICKET_RAG_V2_READ_ENABLED, TICKET_RAG_V2_BATCH_SIZE, TICKET_RAG_V2_QUERY_CACHE_ENABLED, and tenant allowlist default off. Read enable requires meta-dimension and index readiness checks.
rollout_stop_and_failure_policy.stop_conditions: Stop promotion and revert V2 reads to V1 on any unauthorized/stale evidence, citation allowlist bypass, v2-v1 reconciliation unexplained loss, dimension/identity mismatch, provider error budget exhaustion, DB headroom/API regression, or gate miss over the agreed canary window. Pause backfill on DB lock/CPU/IO headroom threshold breach; preserve pending leases for retry. A worker/provider outage degrades to existing v1 lexical path where authorization permits, otherwise returns safe no-context/deferred behavior—never cached stale context.
rollout_stop_and_failure_policy.reconciliation: Periodic reconciler enumerates eligible parents and compares source revision/hash/identity and exact expected chunk IDs with v2; it requeues missing/divergent parents and records counts. It also verifies every snapshot reference resolves to current eligible source before reuse. This gives no-loss/no-stale-write evidence without destructive repair.
rollout_stop_and_failure_policy.retention: Expire snapshots and lease history by approved job/audit retention. Retain v2 chunks only while source remains eligible and purge with source policy. Do not silently retain vectors beyond source/query classification policy.

risks_and_adversarial_checks: Chunk flooding is bounded by max two chunks per parent/ticket and KB reservation; tests use a long malicious parent.
Concurrent database work never shares a SQLAlchemy session; integration tests stress concurrent lexical/vector requests.
A stale cache vector or snapshot cannot bypass live authorization/source checks; dedicated poison cases verify portal, private, cross-assignee, unapproved KB and model-generated content are excluded.
Provider partial/malformed responses, delayed writes and worker death leave refresh rows recoverable and reject unsafe commits.
Index growth/backfill contention is controlled by canary throttles, metrics, pause gates, and later measured maintenance.
retained_unknowns: Actual corpus size, source-length distribution, QPS/repetition, provider maximum batch input/token contract, provider latency, database headroom, and labelled relevance baseline.
Whether a shared encrypted query-vector cache gives sufficient measured benefit to justify its sensitive-data governance burden.
Whether pgvector remains within gates at 1M chunks and actual filter selectivity; external DB remains conditional, not preselected.
scope_exclusions: No code changes are authorized by this plan.
No second production model, cross-encoder, LLM reranking, external vector service, retrieval-result cache, raw secret indexing, or model-generated evidence indexing in this release.
No destructive v1 table alteration or downgrade.

requirements_covered: 1 implementation specificity: parallel v2 schema, indexes, functions, flags, phase map and cleanup are specified.
2 hybrid retrieval: concurrent/independent authorized FTS and vector pools, rank-only RRF, KB reservation and diversity are specified.
3 chunking: deterministic boundaries, IDs, provenance, replacement/delete and parent citations are specified.
4 throughput: durable lease refresh, bounded batches, retries, validation and stale conditional commit are specified.
5 cold latency: scoped in-memory embedding cache and lexical/vector overlap with session safety are specified.
6 two-agent reuse: immutable snapshot identity, validation and conditional reretrieve rules are specified.
7 security: pre-limit predicates and cache/snapshot live revalidation cover every listed poison path.
8 gates: labelled metrics, benchmarks, latency targets and failure injection are specified.
9 operational safety: additive flags, throttled backfill, reconciliation, rollback, retention and stops are specified.
10 proportionate infrastructure: A-G and required hybrids are explicitly decided.
summary: Propose B+C+bounded caching: additive chunked pgvector v2, durable batched embedding refresh, deterministic RRF hybrid retrieval, and one validated snapshot shared by two same-model agents. Preserve V1 throughout rollout and defer external vector infrastructure, LLM reranking, retrieval-result caching, and shared persistent query caching pending measured need and governance approval.
